:::{#exr-scalar-practice}
#### Picking out the scalars among class summaries

A summary of a class of $30$ students can report single numbers or whole lists of numbers.
Consider these three quantities:

- the height of the tallest student in the class,
- the list of every student's height,
- the number of students in the class.

Which of these three quantities are [scalars](#def-scalar)?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

By @def-scalar,
a [scalar](#def-scalar) is one [real number](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers).
Count the numbers in each quantity.

:::
